title: EU Climate & Energy Daily Briefing
subtitle: Wednesday, 29 July 2026 — Key developments from the last 24 hours

highlights.headline: Commission endorses Malta's €60 million Social Climate Plan to support vulnerable households and small companies in the clean transition
highlights.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 29 Jul 2026 The European Commission has today endorsed Malta's Social Climate Plan – the fourth national plan adopted under the Social Climate Fund using revenues from carbon pricing to ensure a fair and inclusive clean transition. Malta's plan will mobilise €60.6 million until 2032, including €45.4 million from the European Union.

highlights.headline: Commission opens in-depth investigation into arbitration award ordering Romania to pay compensation to ten energy investors
highlights.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 29 Jul 2026 The European Commission has opened an in-depth investigation to assess whether an arbitration award ordering Romania to pay compensation to ten investors for changes to a renewable electricity support measure is in line with EU State aid rules.
